records.translation: Ome zarr 升级链接

records.source: How the OME-Zarr 0.5 to 0.6 converter (Convert, Upgrade OME-Zarr) puts the pixel chunks into the new store: True hard-links each chunk file, so the new store takes almost no space and is the same pixels; False copies them. Copies are made anyway where the disk refuses a link. Only the metadata is rewritten; every chunk is checked byte for byte. Default True. Alpha.
records.translation: OME-Zarr 0.5 到 0.6 转换器（“转换”中的“升级 OME-Zarr”）将像素分块放入新存储的方式：True 为每个分块文件创建硬链接，使新存储几乎不占用空间并共享相同的像素；False 则复制文件。磁盘拒绝创建链接时仍会改为复制。仅重写元数据；每个分块都会逐字节检查。默认为 True。Alpha。
